title: Recommendation
description: Unified recommendation record produced by any Autonoma agent. Supports INSIGHT (informational), RECOMMENDATION (suggested action), and ACTION (executable change requiring approval).

type.description: INSIGHT = info only. RECOMMENDATION = suggested action (acknowledge/reject). ACTION = executable change (approve/reject/execute).

summary.description: Detailed explanation of the issue and its business impact

recommended_action.description: What should be done. Null for INSIGHTs.

reason_codes.description: Machine-readable codes explaining confidence or issue, e.g. CONF_FEED_PROCESSING, GTIN_MISSING

requires_approval.description: True only for ACTIONs that execute changes (e.g. publish review reply)

dedupe_key.description: Deterministic key for deduplication. Format: {agent}:{issue_type}:{context_id}:{scope}. Example: merchant:missing_gtin:merchant_123:SHOPPING_ADS:PL

subject_key.description: Optional key identifying the subject (product, location, campaign)

first_seen_at.description: When this issue was first detected (persists across updates)

last_seen_at.description: When the issue was last confirmed present

occurrence_count.description: How many consecutive runs detected this issue

supersedes_recommendation_id.description: If this is a reopened issue, links to the previously resolved recommendation

expires_at.description: Required for INSIGHTs. Optional for others. Null = no expiry.
